source: problem_statement only, 501 chars, from banchmark/datasets/swe_evo.arrow (copy in harness/nexpath_benchmark/sample/sweevo_run20.jsonl)
rules: Both arms receive this exact list, in this order. The control arm differs only by having no NexPath popups.
Every word comes from the task's problem statement. No file name, function name or fix from the gold patch appears anywhere.
Frozen before any run. Never edited after seeing a result.
Each prompt carries an 'assumes' line; after the run each turn is tagged fits / does_not_fit by its 'check'. The tag is reported, never scored.
Typos and missing apostrophes are deliberate — real typing, and they also test that NexPath does not rely on tidy text.

style_targets.pushback_share: strict corrections (pushback + nitpick + failure report): 6 of 20 = 30%; counting the two 'why did it fail' debug turns as user pushback: 8 of 20 = 40%. Real sessions measure 44% (SWE-chat).
style_targets.one_long_paste: turn 1 (spec front-loaded, matching V2's single-prompt runs)

need to do the 2.20 release, heres whats in it

## What's Changed
* build: skip install fpm and ruby on Windows by @skshetry in https://github.com/iterative/dvc/pull/8169
* import-url/update: add --no-download flag by @dtrifiro in https://github.com/iterative/dvc/pull/8024
* fs: optimize dvc list --recursive by @rlamy in https://github.com/iterative/dvc/pull/8150

## New Contributors
* @rlamy made their first contribution in https://github.com/iterative/dvc/pull/8150

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iterative/dvc/compare/2.19.0...2.20.0
